notes.title: Optimization Update
notes.notes: Small Optimization Update, but with noticeable improvements, possibly even significantly reducing RAM usage during long play sessions.

notes.title: Province Optimization Regions - Hotfix
notes.notes:
Province Optimization Regions - Hotfix

Due to an unknown reason, the Province Optimization Regions were incorrect.
This has been fixed in the update.
The file: map/Earth3/data/ProvinceOptimizationRegions.txt

Province Optimization Regions help reduce the number of calculations required when rendering all of the provinces.

notes.title: Send Ultimatums to Your Vassals - Beta Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Join the beta test before the update launch.[/h3]
[code]To try the BETA, please follow these steps:
Open Steam
Right-click on Age of History 3 in your library
Select Properties
Go to the BETAS tab
From the "Beta participation" drop-down list, choose "betatests"
Wait for the game files to update. If nothing happens, restart the Steam client
Launch the game[/code]

[h3][b]Send Ultimatums to Your Vassals.[/b][/h3]

With this beta update, you can now send an ultimatum to your vassals.
You can demand provinces or full annexation.
It is important to have a larger army than your vassal for the ultimatum to be accepted.

You can send an ultimatum by opening the civilization's diplomacy view:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/3f6eb2801baaea397363d2c5256e4176b7830451.png[/img]

Once your army is much bigger, the ultimatum should be accepted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/1c2d9d259afaf05964c798c0547c8fc5fb6c8e3e.png[/img]


New GameValues, GV_Diplomacy.json:

[code]DIPLOMACY_SEND_ULTIMATUM_COST: 10,
DIPLOMACY_SEND_ULTIMATUM_COST_LEGACY: 10,
ULTIMATUM_ARMY_MODIFIER: 1.75,
ULTIMATUM_RELATION_CHANGE: -25,[/code]

notes.title: Players can now release any Civilization as a Vassal - Beta Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Join the beta test before the update launch.[/h3]
[code]To try the BETA, please follow these steps:
Open Steam
Right-click on Age of History 3 in your library
Select Properties
Go to the BETAS tab
From the "Beta participation" drop-down list, choose "betatests"
Wait for the game files to update. If nothing happens, restart the Steam client
Launch the game[/code]

[h3][b]Players can now release any Civilization as a Vassal from a full list of all civilizations in the game.[/b][/h3]

A new beta update introduces greater control over vassal management! Players can now release any Civilization as a Vassal from a comprehensive list of all civilizations in the game.
This feature allows for more strategic empire management, enabling players to reshape borders, delegate governance, and create new diplomatic opportunities.

Whether you want to grant independence to a former rival or establish buffer states, this update provides enhanced flexibility in how you shape the world.

-> Open Council -> Vassals
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/574685220bc3f034de591512514dd1b96fcaa814.png[/img]
-> Select Civilization
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/8d2ff6c3fcdeffbfe3c983eb57bb96f2847b0069.png[/img]
-> Select provinces on map
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/338d1641d16de5c6886a4865a6f81e4d01bb2fd9.png[/img]
-> Release a Vassal
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/930edd0d4dbfad9fdeacd608a60a10ffc63d3828.png[/img]

notes.title: Update QOL improvements
notes.notes:
Added an option to sell provinces by selecting them on the map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/93103b7bcaaf10a8794a54420b480d4a2fdf5cfe.png[/img]

In the sidebar build menu:
[list]
[*] If a building is constructed or under construction in every province, the building button will turn green.
[*] Use the right mouse button to construct the selected building in all provinces.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/ac6c7580c8970add36ee854a226f8cc0fa175b15.png[/img]

The Monaco province now has access to the sea.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/f9439d66cfb74241f7aee48f683520d9b0c0b607.png[/img]

Fixed maximum diplomacy points calculation.
Buildings maintenance cost, fixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/a830438f14f13e0dd94b11fdd80dfff5ddefdb94.png[/img]

Move units AI, pathfinding optimization.

AI will focus more on research buildings.
AI will upgrade military academies more frequently on higher difficulty levels than on normal.
AI will prioritize upgrading military academies for generals more often on higher difficulty levels than on normal.
AI will upgrade the capital city more frequently on higher difficulty levels than on normal.

Increased cost of researching technologies.
Increased cost of recruiting armies.
Increased cost of maintaining an army.
Increased cost of building construction.

New event outcomes:

[code]relations_change=fra=spa=17.5
# Relations between the Civ with tag 'fra' (France) and the Civ with tag 'spa' (Spain) will change by +17.5

relations_set=fra=spa=-25.65
# Relations between the Civ with tag 'fra' (France) and the Civ with tag 'spa' (Spain) will be set to -25.65[/code]

New Language: [b]Estonian[/b]

Small bug fixes.

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
Loading a saved game now correctly loads war reparations data.
Civilization advantages were giving extra gold when loading a saved game.
Taking a loan was resulting in a positive monthly income.
Translation updates.
Catherine II added to the game.
Railways building nerfed.
WWII Chinese flag updated.
Potential fix for scenarios being lost after adding a new scenario.
Minor bug fixes.
